data.description: A Vetala can drain the mental vitality of a grappled opponent. If the vetala establishes or maintains a pin, it drains this energy, dealing 1d4 points of Charisma damage. Additionally, the victim is affected by the spell Modify Memory, as if the Vetala had spent 5 minutes concentrating. The Vetala gains perfect knowledge of any memory it chooses to eliminate using this ability.
data.name: Drain Prana
